tool.title: List a merge request's changed files (GitLab)
tool.description: List the paths one merge request changes.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: Absent: the change proposal of the current branch.

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitLab — the checkout's remote is a GitLab project.
selection.limits: GitLab only. For a GitHub repository use `github-pr-files`. The paths are read from the raw diff, so a file GitLab leaves out of a too-large diff is not listed.
selection.cost: `glab`, authenticated (`glab auth login` or `GITLAB_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call; the whole diff is downloaded.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitLab API another way. A self-managed GitLab answers on its own host, which this record cannot name; `glab` reaches it once `glab auth login --hostname` has been run for that host.

$comment.comment:
`glab mr diff` has no `--name-only`, so the command is a script key: the
script (in the tools layer) runs `glab mr diff --raw` and reads the paths
out of the diff (bean folio-assistant-4dbr, owner 2026-10-24 "Fill both gaps").
